rows.definition: internal/agent/retry.go: env knob bounding the planner's total retry wall-clock budget (default 4h, clamped by maxRetryBudget so a fat-fingered value cannot wedge a run); when raised, the attempt cap rises toward the hard ceiling.
rows.distinction: A retry TIME BUDGET for the agent planner - NOT a memory/fit plan and NOT the harness-selection plan; it caps how long retries may run, not what gets planned.

rows.definition: internal/executionroute/executionroute.go HarnessCandidates: the []string of candidate harness ids a route request offers, from which selectHarness picks one against the available profiles.
rows.distinction: The CANDIDATE SET of harnesses to choose among - NOT the single selected Harness and NOT a memory/fit plan; it is the input options, not a decision.

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_decode.go inKernelPlannerPrefixReuseSupported: reports whether the in-kernel planner can reuse a prefix KV for the given model and backend, gating whether a decode takes the prefix-reuse path.
rows.distinction: A CAPABILITY predicate (can this model/backend reuse a prefix?) - NOT prefixCacheIdentityFromContext (which names WHICH prefix) and NOT a batch/memory plan; it returns a bool, not a plan.

rows.definition: internal/compute/numa_replica_plan.go NUMAReplicaPlan: the plan for how model-weight replicas are laid across NUMA nodes given a per-replica byte size and a reserve budget.
rows.distinction: The NUMA weight-REPLICA layout plan - NOT PlanNUMAReplicas (the func that computes it) and NOT v4ExpertBatchPlan (a routed-expert batch plan); it sizes replicas across nodes.

rows.definition: internal/compute/numa_replica_plan.go PlanNUMAReplicas: computes a NUMAReplicaPlan from the per-replica byte size and reserve budget.
rows.distinction: The FUNC that computes the NUMA replica plan - NOT NUMAReplicaPlan (its result struct) and NOT planV4ExpertBatch (which plans an expert batch, not replicas).

rows.definition: internal/model/madvise_other.go + mmap_other.go: 'plan9' names the Plan 9 operating system in the GOOS build-tag lists of the platforms that fall back to the portable (no-mmap / no-madvise) paths.
rows.distinction: The Plan 9 OPERATING-SYSTEM build target - NOT any fak 'plan' concept; it is a GOOS name that only collides in spelling with the plan family.

rows.definition: internal/conceptcatalog (cmd/fak/concept.go): PlanClassify builds the plan to RECLASSIFY an existing concept row's verdict/fields against the tree, without adding a new row.
rows.distinction: Plans a RE-CLASSIFY of an existing concept - NOT PlanPosition (which plans ADDING a new positioned row) and NOT a memory/fit plan.

rows.definition: internal/conceptcatalog (cmd/fak/concept.go): PlanPosition builds the plan to ADD a new positioned concept row (canonical, definition, distinction, distinct-from) to a rows file and glossary.
rows.distinction: Plans ADDING a new positioned concept row - NOT PlanClassify (which plans re-grading an existing one) and NOT a memory/fit plan.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/codex_mcp_install.go + internal/quality/regression_bisect.go: 'plant' occurs only as an English VERB in comments ('plant artifacts under a directory', 'plant a revision'), never as a fak concept.
rows.distinction: An English VERB that collides in spelling with the plan family - NOT a fak 'plan' (a computed layout/decision); it names an action in prose, not a concept.

rows.definition: internal/model/v4_expert_batch.go planV4ExpertBatch: plans one layer's routed-expert batch load - which selected experts to stage within a byte cap - returning a v4ExpertBatchPlan.
rows.distinction: The FUNC that plans an expert batch load - NOT v4ExpertBatchPlan (its result) and NOT PlanExpertCache (which sizes resident-expert HBM capacity, not a per-layer batch).

rows.definition: internal/model/v4_expert_batch.go v4ExpertBatchPlan: the plan produced for one layer's routed-expert batch - the chosen experts and staging under the byte cap.
rows.distinction: The batch-load PLAN struct - NOT planV4ExpertBatch (the func that builds it) and NOT NUMAReplicaPlan (a NUMA replica layout).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/release_prplan.go prPlanFileList: formats the changed-file list for a release PR plan, truncating to a maxFiles cap for the plan summary.
rows.distinction: FORMATS the PR plan's file list - NOT prPlanResolve (which resolves the plan's base ref) and NOT releasePRPlanGit (the raw git helper).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/release_prplan.go prPlanResolve: resolves the base ref and SHA a release PR plan is computed against (trying origin/<release-branch> then the local branch).
rows.distinction: RESOLVES the plan's base ref/SHA - NOT prPlanFileList (which formats its file list) and NOT releasePRPlanGit (the low-level git runner it uses).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/release_prplan.go releasePRPlanGit: the low-level git command runner (log --name-only etc.) the release PR-plan builder uses to gather commits and files.
rows.distinction: The raw GIT helper for PR-plan building - NOT prPlanResolve (base-ref resolution) and NOT prPlanFileList (output formatting); it just runs git.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_plan_oracles.go resolveGuardOperatorQuestionPlan: resolves an operator question into a planresolve.Verdict - the plan/decision for how the guard should answer or escalate the question.
rows.distinction: Resolves an OPERATOR-QUESTION into a plan verdict - NOT a memory/fit plan and NOT the PR-plan resolvers; it plans a guard's answer to a human-facing question.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/serve.go serveGGUFMemoryPlan: plans whether a GGUF model fits in device memory for `fak serve` given the f32-resident bytes, context-budget tokens, and device fit budget.
rows.distinction: The in-device memory FIT plan - NOT serveGGUFCPUOffloadMemoryPlan (the variant that plans CPU offload when it does NOT fit) and NOT NUMAReplicaPlan.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/serve.go serveGGUFCPUOffloadMemoryPlan: plans the CPU-offload memory layout for `fak serve` when a GGUF model does not fit on-device, given context-budget tokens and the device fit budget.
rows.distinction: The CPU-OFFLOAD memory plan (does not fit on-device) - NOT serveGGUFMemoryPlan (the on-device fit plan) and NOT PlanNUMAReplicas.

rows.definition: internal/loopmgr (cmd/fak/guard_lookahead.go lookaheadSpeculationCandidate): a SpeculationCandidate is one proposed look-ahead action the loop manager may fork-and-roll-out to speculate on before committing.
rows.distinction: A proposed SPECULATION action for look-ahead rollout - NOT HarnessCandidates (candidate harnesses to run) and NOT a memory/fit plan; it is a branch to speculate, not a resource layout.
